LESSON: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN KENYA ● RELIEF ● DRAINAGE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments
Topic 1.3: Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why are physical features useful in a country?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify main physical features in Kenya
2. show main physical features in Kenya on a map

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify main physical features in Kenya
   In simple words: practise until you can identify main physical features in Kenya. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. show main physical features in Kenya on a map
   In simple words: practise until you can show main physical features in Kenya on a map. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage in the examples.
2. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
4. Show that you can: identify main physical features in Kenya

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Locate the main physical features in Kenya using a sketch map or atlas,
2. Undertake tasks that encourage artistic expression as they draw a map of Kenya and locate the main physical features,
3. Digital Literacy: Learners use digital technology to effectively accomplish their own tasks as they use digital and print resources to locate the main physical features in Kenya.
4. Creativity and Imagination: Learners undertake tasks that encourage artistic expression as they draw a map of Kenya and locate the main physical features. Values:
5. Responsibility: Learners engage in assigned roles as they collect and display maps and pictures showing the main physical features in Kenya.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify main physical features in Kenya
2. show main physical features in Kenya on a map

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
